svg.title: A Falcon 9 mission, from countdown to landing
svg.desc: At stage separation the mission splits: the second stage carries the payload to orbit while the booster flies itself home.
svg.text: A Falcon 9 mission, from countdown to landing
At stage separation the mission splits: the second stage carries the payload to orbit while the booster flies itself home.

rect.aria-label: Scrub and recycle, weather or a sensor
Fairing separation, halves recovered at sea
Boostback burn, turn toward the landing site
Entry burn, slow down for the air
Landing burn, one engine, legs out
Booster landed, droneship or landing zone

path.aria-label: Go for launch? to Liftoff: go
Go for launch? to Scrub and recycle: no go
Scrub and recycle to Countdown: next window
Main engine cutoff to Stage separation
Stage separation to Second-stage ignition: second stage
Stage separation to Boostback burn: booster

svg.text: box = step, diamond = decision, rounded = start or end
